hero.title: Dentistry in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: **Dentistry in Mauritius for Indian Students** is an option that English-speaking students interested in a multicultural island country for their clinical training might want to consider. First though you need to ensure that the qualification will be recognized in the country you intend to practise in and that the institution you want to study at is currently offering an approved dental degree.

overview: The Dental Council of Mauritius regulates dental practice and is in charge of recognition and equivalence of qualifications for dental registration. The official website is a must starting for eligibility and professional recognition.

faq.question: What is the duration of the dentistry course in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A professional dental qualification can take around five years, including clinical training, but check the length of the particular program on offer at the time.

faq.question: Is dentistry in Mauritius an option for foreign students?
faq.answer: International eligibility depends on the current admissions policy of the institution. Please confirm if applications are accepted from international students for the intended intake.

faq.question: What is the cost of dentistry in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Could not establish a verified current fee for an active admitting program. • Ask for a copy of the institution’s official annual and total-course fee schedule. Students researching Dentistry Fees in Mauritius should obtain written confirmation of all charges.

faq.question: Can Indian students do dentistry in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Indian students should verify their eligibility for admission and the current National Dental Commission rules on foreign dental qualifications and eligibility to practice in India before they enroll. The erstwhile Dental Council of India issued a notice that NEET qualification was mandatory for Indian citizens, OCI and PIO cardholders wishing to apply for eligibility for foreign undergraduate or postgraduate dental study. Students should check with the relevant Indian authority for current rules. Before deciding to Study Dentistry in Mauritius, Indian applicants should confirm the current requirements with the relevant authorities.

faq.question: Is Mauritius Dental degree automatically recognized in India?
faq.answer: No. Recognition and permission to practice should not be assumed. Confirm the latest Indian regulations and get confirmation about the specific institution and qualification before accepting an offer. The recognition of qualifications to practise dentistry in Mauritius is also regulated by the Dental Council of Mauritius.
